title: Copernicus Center

services.name: Venue Rental
services.desc: Our venue rental options offer reasonable rates, on-site parking, and we welcome outside catering. View our client recommended list of Chicago caterers. With a variety of room choices or room combinations, the Copernicus Center can facilitate weddings, banquets, private parties, meetings, concerts, theatre performances, conferences, or seminars. Description: Built in the 1930’s, our theater is the sole surviving venue with atmospheric-styling of all Chicago theaters. It is accented by classic red theater seats and a breathtaking blue ceiling which resembles a star-filled sky. You will benefit from a large “thrust” stage, TWO (2) dressing rooms, side screens, large movie screen & projectors

services.desc: We have the sole surviving venue with atmospheric-styling of all Chicago theaters, designed by architect Mason Rapp of the prestigious firm of Rapp & Rapp. Built in the 1930’s, it has a unique vintage ambiance missing in most Chicago theaters. It is accented by classic red theater seats and a breathtaking blue ceiling which resembles a star-filled sky. Yes, the stars in the ceiling are lit for performance - a crowd pleaser! Originally a cinema house, much has been achieved to both modernize, but preserve, this jewel of Chicago theaters.
